title: Hr admin
description:
The Human Resources Administrators are the gatekeepers of the organization and are responsible for the accurate screening and initial processing of all new hires and rehires. The HR Administrators work closely with the internal Talent Acquisition Specialist , all Hiring Managers and the HR Specialist to ensure all required paperwork and clearances are processed in a timely and accurate manner. You must be detail oriented and able to multi-task. This is a high demand job requiring the skill to assess and prioritize work projects while collaborating with other departments and team members. Bilingual (Spanish) a plus. This position reports to the Human Resources Manager and will be responsible for:

• Review and validate the accuracy of new hire paperwork submitted by Hiring Managers • Coordinate, schedule and conduct onboarding meetings with potential new hires • Collaborate with the internal Talent Acquisition Specialist plus the HR Specialist for Phipps Neighborhoods and Senior Management for Job Fairs and Summer Hiring projects • Preparing electronic employee offer letters • Processing background check screenings • Ascertaining additional background check screenings required by outside agencies • Coordinate and schedule additional screenings (i.e. fingerprinting with DOH, DOE and State Clearance Registry forms) • Review and process electronic I-9 Forms and other new hire paperwork completed by potential new hires for accuracy • Update and maintain onboarding status logs • Review background check screening results to ensure proper clearances are obtained and consult with the Human Resources Manager and VP of Human Resources when necessary • Process pre-adverse and adverse action letters when required • Ensure compliance with all new hiring screening laws and regulations • Notify Managers of employees cleared for hire and coordinate start dates • Complete New Hire Onboarding process in the Ultpro HRIS system • Coordinate with the Payroll Manager and Benefits Manager when new hires are cleared • Work with Human Resources Manager and Vice President/Human Resources on various projects and perform other duties as assigned Job Requirements: Associates Degree or minimum 60 College Credits required, BA/BS in Human Resources Management or related discipline, preferred. A minimum of 2 years experience in Human Resources related work required with onboarding experience essential. 

The successful candidate will have a proven ability to work independently and as part of a team with the skill to balance multiple projects successfully. Superior administrative and computer skills with a strong knowledge and use of Excel, Word, and HRIS systems essential. The successful candidate must be detail oriented and able to multi-task. This is a high demand job requiring the skill to assess and prioritize work projects while collaborating with other departments and team members. Bilingual (Spanish) a plus.


Prior experience working with DOH, DOE, SCR agency clearances preferred. Must have excellent organizational, interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to exercise sound judgment, make effective decisions in the best interest of the organization and maintaining required confidentiality and discretion is essential.

Must be able to work between the Manhattan and Bronx HR office

title: Marketing & Communications - Web Content Lead and Project Manager
description:
Preferred location is New York, NY (Hudson Yards area), though remote candidates will also be considered. Remote employees must be available to work EST business hours.

We are seeking an experienced Web Content Lead & Project Manager to oversee website content operations across multiple digital properties. This role will be responsible for maintaining web content, publishing high-quality digital experiences, and managing the end-to-end content development, review, and production process.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in content management systems, project coordination, stakeholder management, and digital content operations in a fast-paced environment.

  • Manage content updates and requests through Workfront or similar project management platforms
  • Review incoming web requests and coordinate updates across enterprise web properties
  • Publish updates to live websites and communicate changes with internal stakeholders
  • Provide weekly and monthly reporting on content activities and project status
  • Collaborate with multiple cross-functional stakeholders to ensure timely project completion
  • Maintain and update the editorial content calendar
  • Lead recurring meetings to keep projects on track and aligned with timelines
  • Manage ongoing web and thought leadership content initiatives
  • Serve as the team's subject matter expert for Workfront and content operations processes
  • Edit, create, and publish pages using Contentful CMS or similar platforms
  • Share preview links and gather feedback from project stakeholders
  • Coordinate with creative teams for image sourcing and visual assets
  • Partner with development teams to troubleshoot and resolve website issues
  • Monitor and resolve broken links and website issues through third-party reporting tools
  • Manage expiring content by coordinating updates, removals, or page sunsets with content owners
  • Support content audits, inventory management, taxonomy updates, and URL structure improvements
  • Assist with ongoing content governance and optimization initiative
  • Support website content planning and editorial calendaring efforts
  • Help maintain alignment between content strategy, business goals, and publishing schedules

Must Haves:

  • 4–8 years of experience in web publishing, content management, or content marketing
  • Hands-on experience with Contentful CMS or similar platforms such as Drupal or Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)
  • Experience using Workfront or similar project management tools
  • Strong understanding of content operations and digital publishing workflows
  • Basic working knowledge of HTML
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Familiarity with Associated Press (AP) style guidelines
  • Strong organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to maintain brand consistency across digital properties

title: Web Content Manager
description:
Contract
Hudson Yards, NYC

We are looking for an experienced Website Content Manager to join our client's team. The Website Content Manager is responsible for CMS entry, and managing the content workflow, approvals, and tagging.

Role and Responsibilities
  • Project management of content updates in Workfront platform.
    • Review web requests that come in for updates across website.
    • Manage process of getting content created with writers.
    • Ensure consistency with tags and processes in Welcome.
  • Content updates on platforms.
    • Edit and create new pages for all web platforms in Contentful CMS.
    • Update content for advisors on Seismic.
    • Work with creative on image sourcing and resizing as needed.
    • Send previews to project requester.
    • Coordinate content across platforms.
  • Manage expiring content and broken links.
    • Review broken links report and correct issues.
    • Generate expiring content reports and manage updating them or sunsetting pages with page owners in Welcome.
    • Check analytics and provide recommendations on pages.
  • Content governance support
    • Content audit to categorize all pages and make a determination on next steps based on goals, data, usage, etc.
    • Manage content inventory.
    • Govern videos across platforms to ensure they're within compliance.
  • Content planning support
    • PowerPoint presentation support for content strategy

Skillset Required
  • 3+ years of work experience in web publishing and content marketing
  • Hands on experience with Contentful CMS or similar CMSes like Drupal or AEM
  • Workfront experience
  • Familiarity with Seismic
  • Keen eye for brand consistency
  • Project management and content operations experience
  • Working knowledge of HTML
  • Excellent verbal and email communications skills
  • Familiarity with Associated Press style of writing
  • Great organization skills, time-management, and effective communication
  • Great inter-personal skills and relationship building
  • Perform well under deadlines and be detail oriented
